mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, sn AS sn, crt_dt AS crtDt, msg_cn AS msgCn, rcptn_rgn_nm AS rcptnRgnNm, emrg_step_nm AS emrgStepNm, dst_type AS dstType, visible_yn AS visibleYn FROM disaster_text_history WHERE visible_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO disaster_text_history ( id, sn, crt_dt, msg_cn, rcptn_rgn_nm, emrg_step_nm, dst_type, reg_ymd, mdfcn_ymd, visible_yn ) VALUES
(#{msg.sn}, #{msg.crtDt}, #{msg.msgCn}, #{msg.rcptnRgnNm}, #{msg.emrgStepNm}, COALESCE(#{msg.dstType}, '기타'), NOW(), NOW(), 'Y')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE msg_cn = VALUES(msg_cn), rcptn_rgn_nm = VALUES(rcptn_rgn_nm), emrg_step_nm = VALUES(emrg_step_nm), mdfcn_ymd = NOW()
